**Script (re-voiced, 40 words, Aria, playful, stability 0.4):** [playfully] Meet Python three point thirteen point zero, with a new and improved interactive interpreter. It brings multi-line editing, color support, and colorized tracebacks. Try the experimental free-threaded build. Download it for Windows, macOS, or source, right from python dot org.

**Voiceover length:** The first take (66 words) came to 34.85 s from its file size, over the 29 s a 30 s cut holds, so it was re-voiced once from a shorter script. The second take is 20.20 s and fits. The first take was not used in the cut.
